question: Whether strong SaaS execution is mutually contradictory with weaker transition-period cash conversion, persistent losses, valuation pressure and implementation friction.
whyItMatters: VRNS is packet_ready with complete specialist coverage and score readiness; the remaining gate is unresolved_material_contradiction.
resolution: Not mutually exclusive. SaaS ARR/revenue growth and renewal evidence describe adoption; free-cash-flow conversion, GAAP losses, valuation and customer friction describe transition quality and economics. Existing packet contradictions are already labeled non-gating/contextual tensions. Preserve migration, retention, cash-conversion, valuation and implementation risks as material non-gating risks.
falsifiers: Primary evidence showing reported SaaS growth was not real or was measured inconsistently without disclosure
Evidence that management claimed SaaS growth itself eliminated migration or profitability risk
